verdict.rationale: Obsidian publishes an official TypeScript plugin API (the obsidian-api repo, exposing interfaces such as Vault for file and folder access) plus first-party developer docs and a build-a-plugin tutorial, so developers can build against an official SDK. That SDK is limited to in-app plugins, and the evidence shows no SDK for external or programmatic access; headless Sync is a client, not an SDK. Missing for 10: official SDKs beyond in-app TypeScript plugins (e.g. external/agent-facing or multi-language SDKs), independent hands-on corroboration of the SDK's depth and quality.
